name: Rose Keep — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE labelled architectural GAME ASSET SKETCH SHEET, B04-STRUCT-001 — ROSE KEEP STRUCTURAL SECTIONS. This is a missing component reference sheet, not a full building redesign. Use the ONE attached original Rose Keep image for the local design vocabulary: softly blush-pink limestone masonry, pale cream stone edge mouldings, restrained small muted-gold accents, cylindrical turrets, quiet arched windows, burgundy shingled cone roofs, old climbing-rose keep on irregular rock shoulders. This is a different building from the huge princess palace: preserve the original keep's restrained stone design. No purple onion domes, no large gold lotus capitals, no saturated rainbow-glass palace facade.

Landscape sheet, light ivory background, generous margins, exactly FOUR large separated cells in a clear 2 by 2 grid. Each cell has ONE complete freestanding structural piece in precise three-quarter architectural illustration, detailed cut stone and crisp non-melted profiles, even neutral light, enough depth to see its construction and joining ends. A small simple top/contact line drawing beside the same object is welcome, but no second variant or assembled castle. Each object wholly within its own cell; do not combine or overlap them. Give the exact component ID and short name below each object. Dimensions are proposed, not recovered measurements. Draw as construction reference with subtle colour and fine linework, not dramatic environment art.

TOP LEFT: B04-STRUCT-001-S01 — ROUND TURRET / WINDOW BAND. Proposed outside diameter 12 m, height 12 m, wall 0.6 m. ONE hollow cylindrical stone band, open ring top and bottom, roof absent. Four slim pointed-arch window holes at cardinal directions; windows 1.8 m wide and 6 m from sill to apex, sill 1.2 m above lower ring. Visible holes go through real wall thickness; empty interior, no glazing or floor. Show the ring top enough to read the hollow shell and planar stacking surface. Fine pale stone window dressings restrained, removable ornament omitted. Small plan is concentric circles with four window cuts. Do not attach the source's complete turret, roof or rose plants.

TOP RIGHT: B04-STRUCT-001-S02 — WALL RETURN / ENTRANCE HOST. Proposed width 8 m, depth 4 m, height 6 m. ONE L-shaped thick blush masonry wall: long front wall 8 m wide and 0.6 m thick, with a short 4 m right-hand return continuing behind it. Flat stone end joins. One real EMPTY pointed-arch doorway through the long wall, slightly left of centre: 2.4 m clear width, vertical jamb spring height 3.2 m, apex 3.8 m above the threshold. Background and thickness visible through it; absolutely no solid door or false painted niche. Pale restrained arch stones integrated into host, optional separate carved surround not mounted. Top view clearly shows L footprint. This right-angle return and hidden depth are proposed first-test construction, not surveyed source geometry.

BOTTOM LEFT: B04-STRUCT-001-S03 — CLIFF TERRACE BAY. Proposed width 8 m, depth 6 m, structural height 1.5 m. ONE rectangular level stone terrace module: perfectly flat walkable paving on top, pale edge cornice, blush stone fascia going DOWN below the top. No raised central building or walls, no staircase attached, no railing attached, no scenery. Flat joining ends, clean broad underside contact for a separate rock/support host. Show the full 8 by 6 slab in oblique view with side/underside depth readable. This is a supported terrace component, not a floating garden island. Simple top drawing may mark a clear 2.4 m centre route with dotted lines.

BOTTOM RIGHT: B04-STRUCT-001-S04 — STAIR FLIGHT / TURN LANDING. Proposed width 2.8 m, total depth 5.8 m, total rise 1.5 m. EXACTLY TEN regular planar steps: each 0.15 m rise, 0.30 m tread going, total flight run 3 m. Then ONE 2.8 m square top landing, so total footprint depth 5.8 m. Pale cream stone, slight blush lower substrate, straight constant-width flight, top landing free for forward or right exit. No balustrades, flowers, statues or doorway attached. Low approach and top walking surface clear; thin structural slab underside. A simple side/contact outline can clarify ten risers and the top landing. Do not draw a sweeping grand staircase, many flights or unequal melted treads.

No humans, scenery, plants, floating detail pieces, exploded unrelated parts, perspective distortion, invented extra towers, complete castle, dark backdrop or watermark. It is important that all four pieces are different joinable structures matching the specified functions, not four similarly sized tall blocks. Small footer: PROPOSED CONSTRUCTION • hidden faces inferred • mesh joins and view parity unverified. Keep text outside the object silhouettes.
